gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Noto Sans Siddham offers a large central band and an s with far-hanging ends, easygoing and modern. And Bloody pushes big round bowls up top, loud and commanding beside that gentle text.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Bloody comes in swinging, all big round bowls and commanding attitude. But Noto Sans Sundanese reads cleanly paragraph after paragraph, its open-mouthed crossbars keeping each line tidy and unfussy.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-syloti-na: Bloody shouts through big round bowls and commanding weight. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri handles the quiet work: short ascenders, a tall x-height, and an a whose lower bowl opens to breathe.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-syriac-we: Modern, clean text with terminals held far from the strokes, packed like bundled cable. Noto Sans Syriac Western keeps that tight bundle across page after page, a quiet floor under the commanding bowls of Bloody.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Loud, round and unapologetic up top, with a tidy sans below. The standout is how big round bowls from Bloody meet the high-set midline of Noto Sans Telugu, whose counters stay open to the outside.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana leads wide channels into each counter, giving its big open lowercase forms an approachable, businesslike manner. Bloody grabs the eye with round bowls while the body does the reading.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai reads soft and friendly, its lowercase swollen like glass beads. Over pages of text those rounded, open letters stay relaxed, while Bloody up top keeps its big round bowls loud and commanding.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-warang-ci: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Warang Citi sets words as solid blocks rather than skylines, with wide channels into each counter. Bloody shouts the headline while that body holds the lines steady.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar: Loud round bowls up top, a soaring x-height below. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square keeps wide gaps that hold tiny sizes crisp, so extended reading feels approachable, while Bloody supplies the commanding swagger.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-orienta: Bloody arrives with big round bowls and a commanding growl. Orienta stays modern and level beneath it, its counters breathing like a hollow reed cut open and its cases close in height.
